name: BonBon's
source:
You're a self-isolationist man who needs some money and decides to become a security guard at a local shithole. But for some reason, all of your usual temp jobs are closed to their new competitors, named BonBon's. A strange gentleman's club, unlike anything you've ever seen before. Some of the girls like you, others tolerate you, but you get paid a shitload of money! But something is going on behind the scenes,  and the staff, while friendly, seem to be more than what the owner is letting on. Is there something else at play here? Are these animatronics more than meets the eye? 

[From [url=https://blamboozled.itch.io/bonbons]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是个离群索居、手头拮据的男人，为了赚钱决定去当地一家破烂小店当保安。可不知为何，你平时常干的零工渠道全都被它们的新竞争对手——一家名叫“邦邦俱乐部”（BonBon's）的店给挤垮了。这是一家与你此前所见截然不同的古怪绅士俱乐部：店里的女孩们有的很喜欢你，有的只是勉强容忍你，但老板给你的薪水高得吓人！然而幕后似乎暗流涌动，员工们虽说态度友善，真实底细却远不止老板口中透露的那点。这里背后究竟藏着什么猫腻？这些机械玩偶莫非并不像表面看上去那么简单？

[摘自[url=https://blamboozled.itch.io/bonbons]itch.io[/url]]
